title: feat(list): make inline record editing a configurable, author-controlled property
body:
## What

Make inline cell editing a **first-class, per-view property** with UI to flip it — instead of being effectively hardcoded per render path.

- **ViewSettingsPopover** — a "Record editing" toggle (mobile/compact settings).
- **ListView** — a desktop toolbar toggle button (Pencil) for grid views, plus an `onInlineEditChange` callback; reads `schema.inlineEdit → editable`.
- **ObjectView** (object saved views) — persists the toggle to `viewDef.inlineEdit` via `persistViewPatch`, alongside sort/filter/hiddenFields.
- **InterfaceListPage** (page lists) — reads inline editing from the page block's `userActions.editInline` (default off) → inline editing becomes a page-authored property.
- **types** — declares `userActions.editInline?: boolean` on `ListViewSchema`, mirroring the framework spec (`UserActionsConfigSchema.editInline`).

When on, cells edit with the dedicated `@object-ui/fields` widgets (#2100) — the same controls the form uses, so select→dropdown, boolean→checkbox, date→picker, etc.

## Companion

Framework spec: objectstack-ai/framework#2468 adds `editInline` to `UserActionsConfigSchema`, so the metadata-admin "Interface (list pages)" panel auto-renders the **"Edit Inline"** checkbox. Lands via the normal spec pin.

## Verification

- `packages/types` + `packages/app-shell` `tsc --noEmit` → clean.
- Framework spec unit test (`UserActionsConfigSchema`) → green.
- Type-aware editor injection (data-table ← ObjectGrid `renderCellEditor` → `FieldEditWidget`) verified end-to-end in a prior pass (PATCH 200, value persisted).
